title: City Council District 2
statement: I support the progress made on the Baylight District remediation, particularly the completion of soil test verification and the commencement of Phase II remediation with independent oversight. However, I remain concerned about the commercial decay in Jack London and Downtown. We need to ensure that the growth in one area doesn't overshadow the struggles in another. I will continue to push for targeted support for these neighborhoods.

payload.text: The committee hearing schedule for INIT-008 Downtown Economic Revitalization is set for next cycle. Independent oversight verification for INIT-006 Phase II remediation has been submitted.

movesRejected.reason: second-consequential-move(one per wake — the first valid one stands)
